authorization: User accepted existing-data closeout after rerun reassessment; isolated reruns allowed only if necessary. No additional simulations required.

data_check.figures: Three PNGs visually inspected; labels distinguish retained and new measurements
data_check.timestep_selection: DEFERRED; not certified by this verification

retained_exploration.limits: Old runtime script not recovered; no full common-time q/qd or contact-history diagnostics. Old PCG p95 remains historical reported evidence.

scope_adjustments: Post-drift scan timing excluded from recommendations; power mode unchanged
Do not restart partial N24 or six unstarted S jobs; up to eight cross jobs deferred

deferred_requirements.condition: Before recommending a new timestep: declare tolerances, collect missing q/qd and contact-history observations, verify bounded finer reference and selected r3/r2 candidates
Before formal performance acceptance: review and freeze workload cost/tail/memory criteria; align device state and measurement protocol
Retain p95 64 / hard 200 for subsequent optimization acceptance; no rerunning to discard slow or high-iteration cases
Old runtime script and old precommit logs cannot be restored by new runs
Near-static issue, free grasp calibration and G6/G7 remain in their original phases

downstream_use: Measurement and matrix evidence is available for 8B/8C development and offline studies; formal candidate acceptance still requires matched conditions and finalized budgets.

budget_rules.comparison: Same physical inputs, N/h, PCG tolerances, diagnostic mode and graph mode. Inclusive hierarchy times must not be summed or compared to normal step timing as independent costs.

sharpa-cuda:0-r2.proposed_total_cost_rule: At least five quality-passing quiet repeats; candidate maximum solver wall/sim must be below baseline minimum. Rebaseline on changed hardware/software or unstable workload. Also require setup-amortized total cost improvement over the declared horizon.
sharpa-cuda:0-r2.proposed_tail_rule: No additional regression beyond the observed baseline maximum p95 for each phase; solve and step evaluated separately.

memory.rule: Conservative no-growth draft against observed maxima; an optimization needing more memory requires an explicit revised budget before acceptance.
memory.limitations: Driver process memory sampled each second, not a guaranteed transient peak; HWM includes setup/warmup. Pool allocation and driver usage are separate quantities.
